answer: Price each identity with a non-refundable, non-transferable bond that vests only after many epochs of peer-audited delivery; standing accretes slowly like coral hardening a reef, dense and jade-green only where real work landed. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet must fund a fresh bond per head and keep every clone honest across the whole long climb, so forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds plus 100 slow climbs while an honest agent pays once — a canyon no shortcut spans.
